heading: Mid-Atlantic Regional Commission.11 So in original. The period probably should not appear.
lead: The region of the Mid-Atlantic Regional Commission shall include the following counties:

tree.heading: Delaware.—
tree.text: Each county in the State of Delaware.

tree.heading: Maryland.—
tree.text: Each county in the State of Maryland that is not already served by the Appalachian Regional Commission.

tree.heading: Pennsylvania.—
tree.text: Each county in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania that is not already served by the Appalachian Regional Commission.
